description: agent-fabric-gateway's rules for fabric-pr arm. boundary.paths: the gateway carries every session's credentials and traffic, so its boundary is the credential confinement and upstream transport (crates/backend/), the listener, admission and local authentication (crates/runtime/), the protocol parsers that read a harness's request (crates/protocol/), the plan's API and configuration, where credential references and bind restrictions are validated (crates/api/, crates/config/), observability, where redaction keeps a credential out of a log (crates/observability/), the binary roots (apps/), the wire contracts (architecture/contracts/), the dependency and build surface (Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock at any depth, deny.toml, .cargo/config at any depth, rust-toolchain), CI (.github/), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, auth, tls, crypt, signing, trust, parse, wire). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never for a Cargo.toml, a Cargo.lock or a .cargo/config (dependencies and build configuration are supply surface wherever they are declared): Markdown outside the contracts, the decision records' prose under architecture/adr/, .agent-fabric/, xtask/, tests/, fixtures/ and crates/test-support/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary.
